frozen_before: any result of runs/pilot_20261018_122808 (committed while its pod was in setup)
status: EXPLORATORY: a fixed-parent pilot of local selection sensitivity. It informs whether a formal volume study is worth funding; it is not the formal H1 (which is a full search per treatment) and supports no downstream-capability claim.

measurements.decisions: the root-level decision of every operator under every profile, read from the search's own state journal (structure.json); WIDTH bases recovered from the root child's embedding (width_projection_*.safetensors)

agreement.FFN: per-layer Jaccard of kept_neurons, averaged over the 36 teacher layers
agreement.ATTENTION: per-layer Jaccard of kept_heads, averaged over layers
agreement.DEPTH: Jaccard of the 8 removed layers, and the fraction of the 8 greedy rounds choosing the same layer
agreement.RESIDUAL_WIDTH: subspace overlap ||Q1^T Q2||_F^2 / k of the orthonormalized projections (k = 1024)

measurements.chance_levels: each agreement is reported beside the expectation for two independent uniform selections of the same size (WIDTH: k/n)
measurements.covariates: realized UESP, forward tokens and number of distinct rule families per profile (from profiles.json metadata)

groupings.between_resamples: for each dose d in {1x, 2x, 4x}: the 3 pairs of resamples r1-r3 (DEPTH: the single r1-r2 pair at 1x and 2x)
groupings.nested_to_largest: for each resample r: agreement of its 1x and 2x decisions with its own 4x decision (the profiles are nested within a resample, so this traces convergence along one draw)
groupings.reference_contrast: agreement of each pilot profile's decisions with the forward baseline's historical root decisions under calib.domain_balanced@v1 and calib.reasoning_heavy@v2 (the D1 search's own state journal, scored under all_v1, whose DEPTH orders R0 showed identical to scored_v1). DESCRIPTIVE: a mixture contrast, not a volume result and not a mixture verdict.

reading_rule.per_operator: noise(d) = max - min of the between-resample pair agreements at dose d; effect = mean(4x) - mean(1x); 'stabilizes with volume' if effect > max(noise(1x), noise(4x)) and the 2x mean lies between; 'no detectable volume effect' if |effect| <= max(noise(1x), noise(4x)); 'destabilizes' if effect < -max(noise(1x), noise(4x)). DEPTH (one pair per dose) is reported without a label.
reading_rule.why_noise_calibrated: with three pairs per dose there is no defensible fixed threshold; the observed pair spread is the only noise scale the pilot measures, so an effect must exceed it to be called one
reading_rule.saturation: described, not labeled: whether the 1x decisions already agree with each resample's own 4x decision as closely as two independent 4x resamples agree with each other
